'''Recon team 05''' was a military unit that once participated in a conflict.

==History==
Recon team 05 consisted of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]] [[Lev Palik]] and his spotter, [[Wren Cristol]]. During a conflict on a world, enemy forces dug themselves in along an established line and recon team 05 was ordered to take up a position near an enemy bunker. A group of agents were sent to attack the bunker, so they rendezvoused with recon team 05, who told the agents information about a possible entrance to the bunker.<ref name="Galaxy at War" />
